capabilities: Builds 3D and 2D node networks from markdown tags
Parses topic, sub, vocab and badge tags
Filters graphs by folder and topic
Opens source files at the right line on click
Pins folder, topic and view mode across sessions
disambiguation: Not a replacement for the core Graph view; it builds custom topic and vocabulary nodes from inline tags rather than mapping file links.
extras: Manual installation from GitHub releases only; the Demo Figures section contains no images.
intentEvidence: Go beyond file-only graphs by generating custom nodes inline.
motivation: Originally built for advanced language learning and vocabulary organization, then scaled to general mind-mapping.
problem: Obsidian's graph view only maps files and links, so learners cannot generate custom vocabulary and topic nodes inline.

relations.evidence: Parses both Obsidian ==...== highlights and <mark> tags (we can use the Highlightr plugin)
You can also download the DataView plugin to get the theme treatment for those tags

summary: Interactive 3D and 2D vocabulary graph and mind-map plugin that builds node networks from inline markdown tags.
